name: RSI + native MT5 MACD: frozen M15 raw comparison
raw_gate: A/B: net return >0, net PF >=1.15, >=30 closed trades, and higher net PF AND return than C_MACD_only, in BOTH 3y and 5y. A must also beat D_A_without_RSI in PF and return in both windows to demonstrate RSI's incremental benefit. 60% wins is a separate descriptive objective, never a substitute for this gate.
